Non-US leaders SK hynix, Samsung Electronics, TSMC, ASE, Ibiden, Unimicron, Shinko, and Japanese/Korean materials vendors remain important for the node but are outside this US-listed expansion pass unless ADR/OTC coverage is explicitly allowed.

node: HBM, advanced DRAM allocation, and advanced packaging capacity
summary: Expanded a focused US-listed universe around the HBM/advanced DRAM/advanced packaging chokepoint. The highest-relevance names are not only AI accelerator vendors, but also memory suppliers, outsourced advanced packaging providers, HBM test platforms, probe-card suppliers, and inspection/metrology vendors. This pass prioritizes companies with direct exposure to HBM qualification, package throughput, known-good-die workflows, and 2.5D/advanced packaging process control.
